notes.title: The Recurrence is on a MASSIVE Discount for the Steam Spring Sale!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
If you were thinking about getting the game, now is a great time to do so as we are part of the Steam Spring Sale! From March 14th until the 21st, the game will be on sale for 50% off! 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2790180/The_Recurrence/]The Recurrence Steam Page[/url]
